findings.summary: All 16 corporate membership badge previews lack text alternatives identifying the badge and visual variant.
findings.fix: Add alt text identifying the membership level and variant, for example "Django Bronze Member badge, full colour"; expose variant names in the data supplied to this template.
findings.evidence: Production /foundation/corporate-members/badges/: has no alt; visual inspection confirms text "django Bronze Member".

findings.summary: Member directories, team directory and badge downloads share a generic foundation title that omits their specific purpose.
findings.fix: Override the title block in corporate_member_badges.html, corporatemember_list.html, individualmember_list.html and team_list.html with their page heading and the foundation name.
findings.evidence: Production corporate-members/badges, corporate-members, individual-members and teams all have <title>Django Software Foundation | Django</title>.

passed: Representative production pages have lang="en" and a main landmark.
Corporate sponsor logos have organization-name alternatives; sponsor plan logos are decorative next to text.
Fundraising progress SVG has a descriptive accessible name including funded percentage.
notes: Skipped heading levels alone are not reported as WCAG failures.
Release-roadmap graphic is accompanied by supported/future/unsupported release data tables; its generic short alternative alone is not treated as a failure.
Flatpage and blog database content beyond representative runtime pages is outside this source-only review.
